title: D3 bites
description: User story under REQ-174 for DEFINE step 3 PR 5 (ADR-4131). D3 gets the three bite checks the spec section 4 names (shapes:templateMarkers, shapes:entityJoin, shapes:pathsResolve), stagePolicy exposes an ackable(stage) that is true for D3, D5 and D6, and the readiness CLI --check shapes exits 4 on an unacknowledged D3 failure and 0 when acked at the current hash. D5 and D6 bites land in PRs 6 and 7.
iWant: D3 to run the substantive template, entity-join and path-resolution checks under --check with the same recorded-override channel D3, D5 and D6 share
soThat: a draft shape that is missing its markers, an unjoined entity or a dangling path blocks the gate until I either fix the tree or acknowledge it at the current hash

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given a recordShape with fields: and an httpRoute with method, path, request, response and errors, when D3 runs, then shapes:templateMarkers passes both.
[failure] given an httpRoute missing errors, when D3 runs, then shapes:templateMarkers fails <tacId>:<name> with "missing marker errors".
[happy] given every coreEntity named by exactly one recordShape, when D3 runs, then shapes:entityJoin passes; given one named twice, then it fails TAD.entity:<name> with "2 record shapes".
[happy] given an interface naming a path that exists in resolvedPaths, when D3 runs, then shapes:pathsResolve passes it; given a missing path marked authoredAt: D3, then it passes it.
[failure] given rcf define readiness --check shapes on an unacknowledged D3 failure, when it runs, then it exits 4; acknowledged at the current hash, it exits 0.
[must-not] given --ack on D1, D2, D4, D7 or D8, when freeze runs, then it exits 2 unchanged from 0.29.0.
